title: Crouch End Emergency Help Points
summary: Nearby emergency rooms, urgent medical care, and surface hazard zones for Crouch End.
content:
For all life-threatening emergencies, call 999 or 112 immediately.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals:
- Whittington Hospital (24-Hour A&E): Magdala Avenue, London N19 5NF. From Crouch End Broadway (Clock Tower): ~25 min walk west along Crouch Hill, onto Hornsey Lane or Hazellville Road down to Dartmouth Park Hill, or take bus W7 south to Finsbury Park or bus 41 west from Hornsey Rise.
- Royal Free Hospital (24-Hour A&E): Pond Street, Hampstead, London NW3 2QG. From Highgate station: take bus 214 / 268 towards Hampstead (approx. 20 mins).
- North Middlesex University Hospital (24-Hour A&E): Sterling Way, London N18 1QX. Accessible via Hornsey station east to Tottenham and north along A10.

2. NHS Urgent Treatment Centres:
- Whittington Urgent Treatment Centre: Magdala Avenue, London N19 5NF. Co-located on the Whittington Hospital grounds, open for urgent non-critical care.

3. Local Hazard Notes:
- Valley Runoff: Crouch End sits in a topographical valley between Highgate, Muswell Hill, and Hornsey ridges; severe downpours cause rapid surface runoff and road flooding along Tottenham Lane, Hornsey Rise, and Park Road.

4. Essential Supplies:
Pharmacies and supermarket branches along Crouch End Broadway, Topsfield Parade, Crouch Hill, and Tottenham Lane stock over-the-counter medicine, first-aid equipment, and bottled water.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible (verify locally).
